content: {"paper_id":"W7212177955","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"multi-label-learning","exact_quote":"Partial multi-label learning (PML) learns from over-complete candidate labels","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文研究部分多标记学习，实例候选标签包含全部真标记且可有多个同时成立，属于多标记分类任务。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"All true labels are included in the candidate set, but irrelevant labels may also be annotated.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"监督为过完备候选标签，含无关/不精确标签，论文将其作为核心研究条件，符合弱监督学习定义。"},{"keyword_id":"noisy-label-learning","exact_quote":"under moderate and severe partial-label noise","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文在部分标签噪声条件下评估并处理候选标签中的无关假正例，以噪声监督为研究条件。"},{"keyword_id":"contrastive-learning","exact_quote":"propose a confidence-aware relation contrastive learning framework","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"提出置信度感知的关系对比学习框架，通过样本关系分布对齐进行对比表示预训练。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","exact_quote":"construct semantic relation distributions over current and queued samples","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"方法基于候选标签置信度构造样本间语义关系分布，构建/学习样本亲和关系结构用于表示对齐。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"pseudo-label-self-training","reason_zh":"摘要提到置信度用于构造关系和软消歧候选集，但未明确该置信度是模型预测并作为后续训练伪标签，证据不足。"}],"input_issues":[]}
